H.R. 1234, Some Act of 2025

As ordered reported by the House Committee on Energy and Commerce on March 5, 2025

CBO estimates that enacting H.R. 1234 would increase direct spending by $2.3 billion over the 2025-2034 period and would not affect revenues. Enacting the bill would not increase net direct spending or on-budget deficits in any of the four consecutive 10-year periods beginning in 2035.
